INTRO_KR: Greenbanks is a modern, large-capacity distillery producing world-class whisky in Tasmania - one of the world's most awarded whisky regions. Greenbanks produces whisky for its own brand but also offers contract distilling services and private barrel sales. With an annual capacity of three million litres of pure alcohol, Greenbanks combines efficiency with flexibility, producing spirit from any cereal grain - including malted barley, wheat, rye, and corn, and offering custom mash bills and yeast options. The quality of our whisky has been externally validated, and at the recent International Wine & Spirits Competition (IWSC), we won five category bests. Greenbanks' Vendome stills and advanced automation ensure precision and repeatability, at a scale that delivers premium Tasmanian whisky at an accessible price. From recipe development to bonded warehousing and maturation, Greenbanks offers a complete end-to-end whisky production solution.

INTRO_KR: Old Kempton was founded by a group of friends who shared a love of whisky and a belief that matching passionate people with the finest Tasmanian ingredients would naturally yield exceptional singe malt whisky. Established in 2012, Old Kempton Distillery is proud to be Tasmania's artisan distillery. We use a time honoured, traditional hand-on approach to distilling that priorities patience, attention to detail and connection with the spirit over modernisation, automation and volume. Old Kempton's house style is founded on a clean, elegant spirit that matches the richness of Tasmanian malt with the right fruit and floral characteristics. This spirit is matured in a selection of carefully sourced Australian Tawny, Tasmanian Pinot Noir and American Bourbon casks. Old Kempton works closely with Australian and international partners to provide bespoke bottlings to suit individual customers requirements.

INTRO_KR: On the edge of the village of Havraníky, near an impressive stream, is our winery.The river Thaya was already famous in the period before the Celts. The people of that time named it with the Indo-European word “dheu” or “flowing”. For the next hundreds or perhaps thousands of years, it retained its reputation as a river that divided but also united people. Whether we call it the Dyje or Thaya today, we are paying tribute not only to this life-giving river, but also to hundreds of years of human togetherness and the uniqueness of our wine. In the production of wine we try to preserve traditional practices and at the same time improve the wine with 21st century technologies. The basic series and fresh wines are aged in new stainless steel tanks. But our main passion is wine in oak barrels. We get these from France and Austria, and for each variety and type there is a different size, type of toasting and different wood drying time. We have repeatedly been finalists in the Czech Winery of the Year competition, and in 2023 we became winners in the Medium Winery category as well as overall winners. We give back to nature what it has given us. We farm with respect for the land and water. We farm about 105 hectares of our own vineyards. We produce around 200 000 bottles each year.

INTRO_KR: A wine-growing region that is one of the oldest in Germany, home to the princely family in its 26th generation and a company bearing the same name: Castell. In addition to the Fürstlich Castell'sche Bank and the cultivation of forests and fields, Castell has been dedicated to wine for almost 800 years. In 1659, Germany's first Silvaner vines were planted in Castell. To this day, the local grape variety remains the focus of the winery, which operates according to the strict guidelines of the Association of German Pr?dikat Wine Estates (VDP) and is one of the pioneers of the first classification in Franconia. Its greatest potential lies in the seven VDP-classified single vineyards with valuable soils, five of which are monopoly vineyards, some of which are over 750 years old and planted with vines up to 50 years old. INTRO_KR: Ningxia Qingtongxia Vega Winery Co., Ltd is a winery established in 2014, with a registered capital of 10 million RMB. The winery is located in the core wine-producing area of Gezi Mountain, on the west side of Shuxin Forest Farm along the mountain road in Qingtongxia City. Currently, the company's total assets amount to over 80 million RMB. It is an integrated winery that combines research, grape cultivation, production and sales, as well as tourism. The winery has a total of 800 mu of vineyards, all of which adopt organic cultivation methods. Among them, there are 500 mu of vineyards with an age of 18 years. The main grape varieties planted include Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Marselan, Malbec, Merlot, and Petit Verdot. Due to its location on the eastern foothills of Helan Mountain, the region enjoys a unique microclimate with significant temperature differences between day and night, abundant sunlight, and low rainfall during the grape ripening period. The special soil conditions of light gray calcareous soil and gravelly soil also contribute to the high quality of the grapes. Mr. Zhang Yi, the founder of the winery, has been engaged in vineyard management for 20 years. During these 20 years, he has insisted on the belief that "good wine is made from well-grown grapes."

INTRO_KR: Shui Jing Fang originates from the heart of Chengdu, the center of the Tianfu baijiu-producing region and is celebrated as the "Urban Gem" among the "Six Golden Flowers of Sichuan Baijiu". It is home to the "Shuijing Street Distillery Ruins," a nationally protected cultural heritage site established during the late Yuan and early Ming dynasties. With a legacy of 600 years of uninterrupted brewing, this distillery stands as a quintessential example of ancient Chinese baijiu production and tavern culture, revered as "China's First Baijiu Distillery". Within the distillery, ancient microbial communities, represented by the "Shui Jing Fang No. 1 Microbial Community," have been continuously cultivated. Over nine generations of master distillers, the traditional techniques of Shui Jing Fang, recognized as a national intangible cultural heritage, have been preserved and innovated upon. The interplay of history, microbial communities, craftsmanship, and the local climate has resulted in Shui Jing Fang's distinctive flavor profile, renowned for its "sweet richness, smooth texture, and elegant and aged aroma". To taste Shui Jing Fang Baijiu is to experience over 600 years of distilling techniques.

Vercoope is one the biggest producers of Vinho Verde and occupies an outstanding place in Portuguese market, being in leadership in some wine segments and channels. Internationally, it is represented in 40 countries in 5 continents. The estimated area of Vineyards from VERCOOPE universe is around 3 000 Ha. These 7 cooperatives from 7 villages in Vinho Verde Region: Amarante, Braga, Famalicão, Felgueiras, Guimarães, Paredes and Vale de Cambra, receive the grapes from these small and family winegrowers which are technically accompanied to monitor the grape’s quality."

Now, it joins together 7 wine cooperatives in Vinho Verde Region, near from 3 000 wine producers associated and sells 10 million bottles/year of Vinho Verde wines. With a strong market position in value for money wines, VERCOOPE have conquered more than 100 awards and distinctions in last 4 years and is certified with the high demanding certification IFS – Food, Sustainable Wine Growing and Vegan. Vercoope is one the biggest producers of Vinho Verde and occupies an outstanding place in Portuguese market, being in leadership in some wine segments and channels. Internationally, it is represented in 40 countries in 5 continents. The estimated area of Vineyards from VERCOOPE universe is around 3 000 Ha. These 7 cooperatives from 7 villages in Vinho Verde Region: Amarante, Braga, Famalicão, Felgueiras, Guimarães, Paredes and Vale de Cambra, receive the grapes from these small and family winegrowers which are technically accompanied to monitor the grape’s quality."

INTRO_KR: Omynara is Korea's leading premium winery and distillery, specializing in fine wines and brandies made from native fruits. Located in the pristine highlands of Mungyeong, we are proud to preserve and modernize Korea's rich fermentation and distillation heritage. Our flagship sparkling wine, Omyrose, is the only naturally fermented sparkling wine in Korea made using the traditional Champagne method (Methode Champenoise). Made from 100% omija (Schisandra chinensis), a rare Korean superfruit, Omyrose has been served at major international events, including Olympic games, global summits and state dinners, symbolizing Korea's innovation and elegance. Our top-tier brandy, Dar, is Korea's highest-rated spirit, distilled from premium schizandra berries and aged to perfection. Alongside it, our Baram series highlights apples, plums, and local botanicals with refined character and exceptional balance. Led by Korea's most experienced blending and distillation technicians, Omynara's team brings together science, artistry, and tradition. We never cease pursuing excellence - from raw ingredients to the final sip. We aim to redefine Korean spirits for global audiences, offering luxury, authenticity, and a truly distinctive taste of Korea's terroir.

INTRO_KR: Hubei Shihua Distillery Co., Ltd. was established in November 1997, with its headquarters located in Shihua Town, Gucheng County, Hubei Province. The company mainly engages in the research and development, production and sales of Baijiu, fruit wine and blended wine. The core product of the enterprise, "Shihua Baowangzui", was launched in 2003. It adopts a 20-year cellar aging process and was rated as "China's Highest Alcohol Content" with an alcohol content of 70 degrees. In 2005, it won the gold medal at the International Food Expo, and in 2009, it was collected by the Xiangfan History Museum. In December 2021, it was recognized as a key national leading enterprise in agricultural industrialization. In 2024, the "Shihua" brand was included in the list of Time-honored Chinese brands. The company currently holds 223 trademark information and 84 patents. Its products cover more than ten provinces and cities in China as well as Southeast Asia. The fifth-generation inheritor still holds the position of brewing technology.
